original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction for PDCP Duplication
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
While activation and deactivation of PDCP duplication with CA is done with inband signalling, the setup of duplicated X2-U bearers is not yet part of the current X2AP although it should be.
The following scenarios have to be looked at and need to be supported:
1.	PDCP Duplication is only supported for NR access. Visibility for PDCP Duplication is therefore given on X2 for EN-DC for NR SCG bearers
2.	PDCP Duplication with CA is based on decisions in the en-gNB. But we can consider scenarios where the MeNB node has certain information about CA possibilities in the en-gNB and already allocates a second Xn-U bearer at resources set/modification, otherwise, setup of the second Xn-U bearer would require a second step for setting up the second Xn-U bearer by means of SGNB Modification.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Introduction of assistance information for DL PDCP duplication (38.425 Baseline CR covering RAN3 agreements)
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: In order to allow the node hosting the NR PDCP to take an appropriate decision on when to activate or deactivate PDCP duplication in DL, it is opportune to allow the corresponding node to provide assistance infromation in the form of measurements of DL radio link quality
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
A new PDU Type is defined for assistance information, which includes radio quality assistance information

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Full configuration in UE Context Setup
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
Although it has been clarified in RAN3#99bis, AH1807, 101 and captured in section 8.4.1.1 of TS 38.401 that 
“the UE CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message may contain source cell group configuration to allow gNB-DU to perform delta configuration”, 
“In case the gNB-DU receives the UE CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message without the source cell group configuration …, it shall perform full configuration and indicate that it has applied full configuration in the UE CONTEXT SETUP RESPONSE message.”, 
and “On Inter-gNB-CU Mobility, same method is performed to achieve full configuration and delta configuration”, 
it may be beneficial to capture also in stage 3 how the gNB-CU allows or does not allow gNB-DU to perform delta configuration by including or not including source cell group configuration in UE Context Setup procedure.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Add the corresponding description that if the received CU to DU RRC Information does not include the source cell group configuration, the gNB-DU shall generate the cell group configuration using full configuration. Otherwise, delta configuration is allowed.

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
The impact can be considered isolated because the proposed modification affects only the UE context setup procedure.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Full configuration IE included in the UE Context Modification Response
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: Currently the gNB-DU can inform the gNB-CU in the UE Context Setup Response message of whether a full configuration shall be applied. This information may need to be included also in the UE Context Modification Response message for the cases of reconfiguration with synch at intra gNB-DU mobility
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Add Full Configuration IE in the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION RESPONSE message
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR is backward compatible since an optional IE is added.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: CR on PWS segmentation over F1
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: In current TS38.473, the Write-Replace Warning procedure can transmit one SIB message only at a time. If segmentation is applied to a warning message, multiple Write-Replace Warning procedures should be triggered to transmit one warning message. This procedure is inefficient for warning message considering its urgency.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Add additional SIB message in PWS System Information IE of Write-Replace Warning Request Message

Impact Analysis: 
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR has an impact under functional point of view. 
The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects Write-Replace Warning.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Full configuration indication from gNB-CU to gNB-DU.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: Currently the gNB-DU can inform the gNB-CU in the UE Context Setup Response message of whether a full configuration shall be applied. However, for cases like handovers or inactive to active transistions, the target gNB-CU may need to inform the gNB-DU that it needs to apply full configuration.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Add Full Configuration IE in the UE CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message and in the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR is backward compatible since an optional IE is added.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Extending the MDBV Range
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
SA2 sent LS S2-1907955 asking RAN1, RAN2 and RAN3 whether increasing the MDBV (Maximum Data Burst Value) by the suggested value of 500 times would cause any issues in RAN, and asking CT3 and CT4 to provide feedback on whether it is acceptable to increase the maximum allowed value of MDBV for signalled 5QI characteristics to 2000 kbytes (or another maximum value suggested by RAN1/RAN2).

RAN2 sent a reply LS R2-1911859 indicating that “RAN2 did not identify a blocking issue with increasing the values of MDBV”. RAN3 also replied that this is feasible in R3-194553. Other WGs also provided similar feedback.

In response, SA2 has now asked (in S2-1910663) RAN3, CT3 and CT4 to support the increased maximum allowed value of MDBV for signalled 5QI characteristics, to 2000 kbytes.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary: The Maximum Data Burst Volume IE is extended to 2000 kbytes using the fact that it was defined as an extensible integer.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction of LTE-M Indication
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: Current TS 36.413 doesn’t mandate the storage of the LTE-M indication when received in the UE CAPABILITY INFO INDICATION message. However this indication is to be used at a later stage e.g. when E-RABs are released and therefore requires storage.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
The MME shall store the LTE-M indication when supported and received in the S1AP UE Capability Info Indication message.

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR only has an impact on the UE Capability Info Indication function.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Miscellaneous clean-ups to 37.473
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
During the UE Context Modification Required procedure, the DL UP TNL Information is allowed to be modified by ng-eNB-DU but not ng-eNB-CU. However, the current semantic description is wrong.
The Cell Group Config IE in ASN.1 shall be removed because it was not used.
The reference of the IE “RRC Reconfiguration Complete Indicator” is wrong.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Change the reference of RRC Reconfiguration Complete Indicator IE from 9.3.1.27 to 9.3.1.28.
Update the semantic description of DL UP TNL Information IE in the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUIRED message.
Remove CellGroupConfig in ASN.1.

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release) 
This CR has an impact under functional point of view. 
The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects the UE context modification request.

This CR is non-backward compatible.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction to 37.473 on PWS related procedure
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
The PWS FAILURE INDICATION message contains a Number of Broadcast IE which does not exist in the S1AP and NGAP. It should not be used in this version of the spec.
Both the IEs Cell Broadcast To Be Cancelled List and Cancel-all Warning Message Indicator are optional in the PWS CANCEL REQUEST message. It is not clear how to use the IE without procedural text.
The Notification Information should be supported for public warning.
The Additional SIB Message List should be supported for public warning.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
The Number of Broadcasts IE in the PWS CANCEL REQUEST and PWS FAILURE INDICATION messages is deleted.
Add the procedural texts and semantics description related to Cancel-all Warning Message Indicator and Cell Broadcast To Be Cancelled List IEs in the PWS CANCEL REQUEST message.
Add the Notification Information IE in the PWS System Information IE and the PWS CANCEL REQUEST message, and also the related procedural texts and ASN.1.
Add the Additional SIB Message List IE in the PWS System Information IE, and also the related procedural texts and ASN.1.

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release) 
This CR has an impact under functional point of view. 
The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects PWS failure indication, Write-replace warning and PWS cancel.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: SCTP association change when current SCTP association is failed (X2)
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
For multi-SCTP, it is unclear which node initiates the TNL binding update, e.g. when there is a SCTP failure. There is no description for how the TNL binding update is performed.

In addition, the description for “one eNB and en-gNB pair” is already moved to the next paragraph, but forgot to delete the first  “one eNB and en-gNB pair”.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Add the support that the NG-RAN node can select a new SCTP association when current SCTP association is failed.

Also delete the first “one eNB and en-gNB pair”.

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has no impact with the previous version of the specification (same release) because it adds the missing behavior for TNL binding update.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Addition of abnormal conditions in Write-Replace Warning procedure
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: According to existing F1AP procedures, when a WRITE-REPLACE WARNING REQUEST message is received the gNB-DU must check whether the Notification Information IE in the PWS System Information IE is different from those of ongoing broadcast warning messages. However, the Notification Information IE is optional and the gNB-DU behavior is not clear if the Notification Information IE is absent.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
If the Notification Information IE is absent from the PWS System Information IE of the WRITE-REPLACE WARNING REQUEST message, the gNB-DU considers this a logical error.

Impact analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): This CR has an impact under protocol point of view. The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects one system function, namely Write-Replace Warning.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Failure case of user location report
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
The Location Reporting Request Type IE is included in the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message and HANDOVER REQUEST message. If the location report request type contains multiple areas of interest set with the same Location Reporting Reference ID, or some other reasons, the NG-RAN can not perform the location report, and need to inform the AMF. 
However it is not clear which option the NG-RAN shall perform: 
Option1: fail the initial UE context setup or handover procedure with failure response
Option 2: succeed the initial UE context setup or handover procedure. Then the NG-RAN sends a LOCATION REPORTING FAILURE INDICATION message to the AMF with a cause value.  
Option 3: introduce a new indicator in the successful response message to inform AMF (new IE is needed), but not fail the procedures. 

Option 2 is preferable. But currently the Location Reporting Failure Indication is used on in case of the Location Reporting Control Procedure as follows. 
The purpose of the Location Reporting Failure Indication procedure is to allow the NG-RAN node to inform the AMF that the Location Reporting Control procedure has failed. The procedure uses UE-associated signalling.
Hence it is proposed to update the purpose of the Location Reporting Failure Indication procedure.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Update the purpose of the Location Reporting Failure Indication procedure to allow the NG-RAN to report in case that the requested location reporting action has failed, so as to cover all location reporting failure cases 
 
Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release) because it corrects the NG-RAN behaviour when it is not able to perform the location report signalled in the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message and HANDOVER REQUEST message.
The impact can be considered isolated.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction of NAS PDU is PDU Session Modify
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: There are cases where the PDU session modification is not failed and still the received NAS PDU should not be sent to the UE.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
For a PDU session requested to be modified, correct the condifition for the NG-RAN node to send the received NAS PDU to the UE.

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR only has an impact on the PDU Session Modify function.
If the SMF is Rel 15 or early Rel 16 and the NG-RAN node is supporting the CR, the NG-RAN node should not send PDU session NAS-PDU to the UE in some cases, but SMF may act as the NAS PDU is sent;
If the SMF is supporting the CR and the NG-RAN node is Rel 15 or early Rel 16, the NG-RAN node may send the PDU session NAS-PDU to the UE in some cases, but SMF will consider the NAS PDU is not sent

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction for SN Terminated (option 3x) GBR bearer establishment
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: In NR-DC scenarios with SN terminated split bearer, the MN indicates to the SN the Offered GBR QoS Flow Information at the MN within the S-Node Addition request message over Xn interface. However, this information is missing to be signaled to the gNB-CU-UP over the E1 interface when the Bearer Context is setup.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Introduce Offered GBR QoS Flow Info IE to the QoS Flow QoS Parameters List.

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has an impact under functional and protocol point of view. 
The impact can be considered isolated because the change is limited to GBR Bearer Context Setup scenarios.
The CR is ASN.1 backwards compatible.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Cell Creation Rejection when max number of supported cells is exceeded at CU CR 38.473
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: If a gNB-CU that has already added a number of cell close to its maximum number of supported cells receives a request to add more cells, e.g. by receiving Served Cell Information in F1 Setup Request or gNB-DU Configuration Update, thereby exceeding its maximum number of supported cells. There is currently not an adequate guidance on how to handle this case in TS 38.473. Currently there is no way to indicate the reason of a rejection due to maximum number of supported cells being exceeded.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Add a new cause value, CU Cell Capacity Exceeded.

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has no impact under funtional point of view.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Handling OVERLOAD START message in the N3IWF
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
For non-3GPP access, the following establishment causes are not used. 
-	mt-Access, mo-VoiceCall, mo-VideoCall, mo-SMS, notAvailable, mo-ExceptionData 
But the establishment cause value in the INITIAL UE MESSAGE, refers to TS 23.502, including all (RRC) establishment cause values.  

Further, the procedural texts on Overload Action IE in TS 38.413 describe all (RRC) cause values. It should be clarified that for non-3GPP access, that cause values only applicabe to non-3GPP access are used for overload control message in TS 29.413.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Update the reference of establishment cause in INITIAL UE MESSAGE from TS 23.502 to TS 24.502.
Update that only establishment cause values specified in TS 24.502 are used for the identification of traffic for the Overload Action IE in Overload Start message.
 
 
Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release) because it clarifies that cause values only applicable to non-3GPP access are considered for Overload Start and Initial UE message.
The impact can be considered isolated because the change only affects the overload control function for non-3GPP access.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Support of release on CAG subscription change
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
At RAN3#108-3, RAN3 sent an LS to SA2 (S2-2004808/R3-204324) raising concern that the HO procedure triggered by the mobility restriction list change is a new behaviour (and that the MRL is only used to control subsequent mobility in CM-CONNECTED).

SA2 has now changed their specifications as per LS sent (S2-2005904). As a result, at least in some cases as described in the CRs, the AMF requests the release of the AN connection after a CAG subscription change.

However currently the existing cause values for NPN are tightly linked to access rejection only. Typical use case for release is instead when the mobility restriction is updated while the UE is in connected mode (i.e. not linked to access).
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
The scope of an existing NPN cause value is extended to cover also the release use case. Note that this would already be the case anyway at access from a procedural point of view (i.e. the RAN receives a release command), but the release would happen immediately after the UE’s access.

Impact analysis: 
This CR has isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release). 
The impact can be considered isolated because the change only affects the PNI-NPN functionality, and because it only extends the use of an existing cause value.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Support of release on CAG subscription change
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
At RAN3#108-e, RAN3 sent an LS to SA2 (S2-2004808/R3-204324) raising concern that the HO procedure triggered by the mobility restriction list change is a new behaviour (and that the MRL is only used to control subsequent mobility in CM-CONNECTED).

SA2 has now changed their specifications as per LS sent (S2-2005904). As a result, at least in some cases as described in the CRs, the AMF requests the release of the AN connection after a CAG subscription change.

For the INACTIVE case, on receipt of the UE Context Release command with a NPN related cause value, the last serving gNB may decide to explicitly release the UE (as per clause 9.2.2.1 of TS 38.300). If in this case the UE responds in a different gNB, and the gNB receives a RETRIEVE UE CONTEX REQUEST, it may respond with RETRIEVE UE CONTEXT FAILURE. In this case, it seems useful for the gNB to be able to indicate  a cause value which is aligned with that received from the CN so the access gNB can take appropriate action (i.e. release the UE). Currently (as in NGAP), the existing cause value is linked to access and not to release.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
The scope of an existing NPN cause value is extended to cover also the release use case. Note that this would already be the case anyway at access from a procedural point of view (i.e. the RAN receives a release command), but the release would happen immediately after the UE’s access.

Impact analysis: 
This CR has isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release). 
The impact can be considered isolated because the change only affects the PNI-NPN functionality, and because it only extends the use of an existing cause value.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction on Coverage Enhancement Restrictions
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
Coverage Enhancement Restrictions (Enhanced Coverage Restriction IE and CE-mode-B Restricted IE) are introduced in NGAP messages to provide information on the restriction information of using Coverage Enhancement.
They should also be included in CONNECTION ESTABLISHMENT INDICATION message, to be used for UE using Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary: Introduce Coverage Enhancement Restrictions (Enhanced Coverage Restriction IE and CE-mode-B Restricted IE) in CONNECTION ESTABLISHMENT INDICATION message.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction on the configuration of subframe #0 and #5 for MCH in MBMS dedicated cell
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
In dedicated MBMS cell, it should be possible to configure all subframes including subframe #0 and #5 as MBSFN subframe(s). However, (P)MCH cannot be scheduled in subframe #0 and #5. In particular with the introduction of 3ms MBMS slot length (i.e., 0.37kHz subcarrier spacing) in Rel-16, it is necessary that subframe #0 and #5 can be used for (P)MCH to improve network resource utilization as shown in figure below.



Therefore, it is important that MBMS area configuration can schedule the (P)MCH in subframe#0 and #5.

This is supported in RRC signalling after approval of CR#4259r2 (R2-2004429), so M2 needs to align.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
A new extension is added to the MBSFN Subframe Configuration IE, which enables subframes #0 and #5 to be scheduled in an MBSFN area.

Impact analysis: 
This CR has isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).
The impact can be considered isolated because the change only affects the scheduling functionality (MBSFN Subframe Configuration).

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: NPRACH configuration exchanging
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: NR Cell PRACH Configuration and E-UTRA PRACH Configuration are exchanged over Xn interface to support RACH optimization, but the NPRACH configuration exchanging was missing.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Introduce NPRACH configuration in Served Cell Information E-UTRA IE

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release) because it only related to NB-IoT SON.
This CR has an impact under functional point of view. 
The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects the RACH optimization for NB-IoT.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Support of Direct Data Forwarding for Inter-System Handover
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: For inter-system HO, direct data forwarding is not supported in case the source node or target node implements CP/UP separation. At bearer context setup or modification, the gNB CU CP may need to transfer mapping information between QoS Flows and data forwarding addresses to the gNB CU UP. Also for other handover cases, the CU-CP can provide data forwarding information to CU UP.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
The CU-CP may provide transport layer information to CU UP for handover data forwarding purposes.

 Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR only has an impact on the handover function.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction of F1AP positioning procedures
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
The issues addressed by this CR are summarized below. Please note that #10 is an ASN/tabular mismatch, resolved by aligning the tabular.

Several procedures miss the statement on use of (non-)UE associated signalling.
Missing procedural text for a number of optional IEs in multiple procedures
Purpose of Positioning Measurement procedure is unclear.
Some IE names are incorrect
Statement on when information is included for all TRPs in the TRP Information Exchange procedure is incorrect
Text in the Positioning Information Exchange procedure seems not to allow failure, and the text in the unsuccessful operation is also incorrect.
Text in the Positioning Activation procedure does not specify clearly the actions for semi-persistent and aperiodic SRS, and the failure for aperiodic is not specified.
Text in Positioning Deactivation has a “shall” for a mandatory IE.
E-CID procedures include a “Cell Portion” request, but is is not clear whether “Cell Portion” should always be included if available.
The Measured Results List IE is mandatory in tabular, but optional in ASN.1, the tabular implies also that it is not possible to send the Geographical Coordinates IE in case of “Cell Portion” request.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Statement on use of (non-)UE associated signalling is adde
Missing procedural text for optional IEs is added in several procedures
Purpose of Positioning Measurement procedure is clarified..
Correct IE names where needed
Correct statement of when information is included for all TRPs in the TRP Information Exchange procedure
Correct text in the Positioning Information Exchange procedure
Text in the Positioning Activation procedure is corrected and the failure for aperiodic is specified.
Text in Positioning Deactivation is corrected.
E-CID procedures are corrected so request is “Default” instead of “Cell Portion”, and “Cell Portion” is always included if available.
The Measured Results List IE is changed to optional in tabular to align with ASN.

Impact analysis: 
This CR has isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release) because it only impacts the positioning functionality.
The impact can be considered isolated because the changes in almost all cases clarify wrong/incorrect procedural text, or in one case, correct misalignment  of tabular.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction of NRPPa positioning procedures
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
The Positioning Information Update procedural text should be clarified from the receiver’s side.
When the gNB receives a POSITIONING ACTIVATION REQUEST message with an indication of the Aperiodic SRS resource trigger to activate, but it could not trigger it, the gNB shall send a failure message. This behaviour must be clarified in the Unsuccessful Operation section. 
There are two Muting Pattern IEs in PRS Configuration IE, and the difference between them is not detailed. If not clarified, the reader may interpret that the IE is signalled in duplicate.
Missing procedural text for a number of optional IEs in response procedures.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Procedural text improvement to clarify the purpose of the Positioning Activation and Measurement Update procedures.

Added semantics description to distinguish between the two Muting Pattern IEs in the PRS Configuration IE

Impact analysis: 
This CR has isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release) because it impacts procedural texts only.
The impact can be considered isolated because it covers only editorial corrections.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Introducing AQP in path switch request acknowledge message
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
It is described in section of 4.9.1.2.2 in 23.502 that:
" 6.	SMF to AMF: Nsmf_PDUSession_UpdateSMContext Response (N2 SM information)
……
If the Source NG-RAN does not support Alternative QoS Profiles (see TS 23.501 [2]) and the Target NG-RAN supports them, the SMF sends the Alternative QoS Profiles (see TS 23.501 [2]) to the Target NG-RAN on a per QoS Flow basis, if available.
7.	AMF to NG-RAN: N2 Path Switch Request Ack (N2 SM Information, Failed PDU Sessions, UE Radio Capability ID). "
The main intention is to allow the NG-RAN to receive the AQP parameters from the CN during the Xn based handover, and perform the notification control at the first place. Hence there is a need to align stage3 spec with the stage 2 spec. 

Note that at this time, the QoS flow already successfully passes the admission control at the target NG-RAN node based on the requested QoS parameters sent from the source NG-RAN. This means that there is no need for the target NG-RAN node to feedback any admission control result upon reception of the Alternative QoS Parameters Set List IE.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Add the AQP parameters in the PATH SWITCH REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message. 
 
Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has impact on the path switch request.
This CR has an impact under functional point of view. 
The impact can be considered isolated since it impacts path switch request.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction of alternative QoS profile
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
In RAN3 #108e meeting, the TP R3-204193 was agreed to support Alternative QoS Profile over Xn during HO and Notification control procedure. However, no changes were introduced to the S-NG-RAN node addition procedure and S-NG-RAN node modification procedure.

For MN initiated SN addition/modification procedure, according to current specification, if a GBR QoS flow with alternative QoS profile is mapped to a SN terminated bearer, the S-NG-RAN can only rely on the basic QoS profile to determine to accept or reject the QoS flow. 

If a GBR QoS flow with alternative QoS profile is mapped to a MN terminated bearer, the S-NG-RAN can only rely on the DRB QoS to accept or reject the DRB. In other words, the AQP feature is not supported in S-NG-RAN addition or modification procedure. 

In addition, with respect to the Notification Control Indication procedure, in the procedure texts, S-NG-RAN node is only allowed to indicate current QoS parameter set index for SN terminated bearer, i.e., it is not supported for MN terminated bearer. But the MN also needs to know this for MN terminated bearers in order to inform CN.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Enable the S-NG-RAN node to feedback the current QoS profile index during the S-NG-RAN node addition procedure and M-NG-RAN node initiated SN-NG-RAN node modification procedures.
Update the procedure text of Notification Control Indication procedure to enable S-NG-RAN node to provide QoS parameter set index for MN terminated bearer.

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR only introduces the support of alternative QoS profile during the S-NG-RAN node addition procedure and S-NG-RAN node modification procedure.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction of alternative QoS profile
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
In RAN3 #108e meeting, the TP R3-204194 was agreed to support DRB level Alternative QoS Profile over F1. However, the changes were only performed on the Notify procedure. 

According to the existing specification, the DU is not able to perform selection on the Alternative QoS profile during the UE Context Setup procedure and UE Context Modification procedures. It means during these procedures, only the CU, which does not well know the Uu condition, makes the decision on the Alternative QoS procedure without any DU report.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Enable the DU to feedback the DRB level current QoS parameters set index during the UE Context Setup procedure and UE Context Modification procedures.

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR introduces the support of alternative QoS profile coordination during the UE Context Setup procedure and UE Context Modification procedures.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Corrections to tabular and asn.1 for NR positioning (F1AP)
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: Correction of errors in the tabular and ASN.1 that were introduced by CR0008r19 (RP-201849).
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
ASN.1 backwards compatible changes:
Alignment of tabular with ASN.1
General cleanup
Factorization of several IEs in the ASN.1, e.g. PRS-Resource-ID, PRS-Resource-Set-ID, and SSB-Index.

ASN.1 non-backwards compatible changes:
9.3.1.166 & ASN.1: max value of UL SRS-RSRP should be 126 (see Table 13.3.1-1 of TS 38.133)
9.3.1.167 & ASN.1: If Local Coordinate System (LCS) is used for UL Angle of Arrival, there does not seem to be any way to provide the LMF with the LCS to GCS translation so this is added to the encoding.
9.3.1.169 & ASN.1: Relative Path Delay should not be extensible (see e.g. Table 10.1.23.3.3-1 of TS 38.133)
9.3.1.177 & ASN.1: In PRS Configuration IE, align with TS 37.355:
Sequence ID, Resource Slot Offset, and Resource Symbol Offset should not be extensible.
RE Offset needs to be extensible (see dl-PRS-CombSizeN-AndReOffset-r16 in TS 37.355)
QCL Info should be CHOICE type rather than SEQUENCE type (see DL-PRS-QCL-Info-r16 in TS 37.355) and PCI added to SSB information
9.3.1.192 & ASN.1: In Carrier Bandwidth IE, min value of INTEGER changed from 0 to 1.
9.3.1.193 & ASN.1: In SRS Resource IE, Slot Offset IE is deleted (redundant with Offset IE).
9.3.1.194 & ASN.1: In Positioning SRS Resource IE, align with RRC:
“slot20480” value deleted from Periodicity IE (in alignment with SRS-PeriodicityAndOffset-r16 in RRC).
In Spatial Relation using SSB, presence of NR PCI IE changed to M, and SSB Index IE changed to O (in alignment with SSB-InfoNcell-r16 in RRC), as a consequence removal of SSBPos from ASN.1 due to duplication with SSB.
In Spatial Relation using DL-PRS, presence of DL-PRS ID IE changed to M, and DL-PRS Resource ID changed to O (in alignment with DL-PRS-Info-r16 in RRC).
9.3.1.195 & ASN.1: In Slot Offset IE, min value of INTEGER changed from 1 to 0.
9.3.1.198 & ASN.1: The LCS to GCS Translation should be optional, since it is not needed if the azimuth and elevation are provided in GCS.
Other ASN.1 changes (e.g. alignment with tabular and/or RRC, fix errors, etc.)
AperiodicSRSResourceTrigger IE encoding corrected
In LCS-to-GCS-TranslationItem, alpha-fine, beta-fine, and gamma-fine are made optional in alignment with tabular.
NZP-CSI-RS-ResourceID made non-extensible
In SRSCarrier-List-Item, pointA made non-extensible.
SRSPosResourceID made non-extensible.
SRSResourceID made non-extensible.

Impact analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): This CR has an impact under protocol point of view. The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects one system function, namely NR positioning.

This CR includes non-backwards compatible changes.

This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR only has an impact on the BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST procedure.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Add the support for updating RG Level Wireline Access Characteristics and Global Cable ID
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
As defined in SA2 TS23.316, the RG Level Wireline Access Characteristics can be updated. 
 - The AMF updates 5G-RG context and FN-RG context stored at W-AGF to modify the RG Level Wireline Access Characteristics.

But the RG Level Wireline Access Characteristics IE is missing in the NGAP UE CONTEXT MODIFIACTION REQUEST message. 

Per the agreed C4-204455 and TS23.316, the W-AGF ULI includes Global Cable ID of the CRG connecting the N5GC device.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Add the RG Level Wireline Access Characteristics IE in the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message. 

Add the Global Cable ID in the W-AGF User Location Information IE.

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release) because it clarified the IE that is not applicable to non-3GPP access, and add the support for updating RG Level Wireline Access Characteristics and Global Cable ID.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction on Industrial IOT Rel-16 PDCP duplication for E1AP
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: For PDCP Duplication IE or Additional PDCP duplication Information IE, the behavior of responding UP Transport Layer Information IEs is described only for CA-based duplication in 8.3.1.2 and 8.3.2.2 (when only one cell group is included in the Cell Group Information IE for the concerned DRB), which however applies to DC-based duplication as well.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary: The description of PDCP Duplication IE and Additional PDCP duplication Information IE in 8.3.1.2 and 8.3.2.2 are modified to accommodate both CA-based and DC-based duplications.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction of RLC Duplication Information over F1
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
The RLC Duplication Information IE is introduced in UE CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST Message in case that the indicated DRB is configured with more than two RLC entities. 

But in ASN.1 the RLCDuplicationInformation is wrongly implemented in the UE CONTEXT SETUP RESPONSE. 

Further the semantics descriptions for DC Based Duplication Activation IE in UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST is referring to “RLC Duplication activation”, which should be corrected to “RLC Duplication Information”.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Remove the RLCDuplicationInformation from the UE CONTEXT SETUP RESPONSE message, and add it in the UE CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message in ASN.1. 
Update the semantics descriptions for DC Based Duplication Activation IE in UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST.  

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
The impact can be considered isolated because this affects PDCP duplication with more than two RLC entities.

ZTE: agree with Huawei

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Introducing UE radio capability ID in Connection Establishment Indication
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
In Rel-16, the Connection Establishment Indication message is used for CP CIoT 5GS optimimizaiton to establish the UE-associated logical NG-connection, or to trigger to obtain UE radio capability. This message can be used not limited to NB-IoT UEs.

And the UE radio capability ID is signalled to the NG-RAN avoiding to include the full set of UE capability over related interfaces, in the RACS Rel-16 topic. 

Hence there is a need to include the UE radio capability ID in Connection Establishment Indication message, except for NB-IoT UEs.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Introduce the UE radio capability ID in Connection Establishment Indication message, except for NB-IoT UEs. 
 
Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release) because it only impacts on the Connection Establishment Indication procedure. 
The impact can be considered isolated.

full_retained_Agreement.content:
A standardized solution enabling an inter vendor interoperable way for an NG RAN node to deduce the identity of another NG RAN node from the received I-RNTI is needed
Agree on the benefits of a solution that allows at least some flexibility in the selection of the Local Node ID length; further details FFS
R3-206763	Cause value on X2, Xn and F1 for insufficient UE capabilities and normal release
Type: discussion		For: (not specified)
					Source: Ericsson, Verizon Wireless, Deutsche Telekom, CMCC
Discussion:
Nokia: why cause value “normal”?
Ericsson: normal cause value is in X2/Xn, but not in other interfaces
Huawei: still checking use case; if SN rejects, other cause values can be used at the moment. This is unclear.
Ericsson: e.g. insufficient resources cannot be used if UE is incompatible; connection might be retried (and fail) multiple times.
Decision: 		The document was noted.

R3-206968	CB: # 95_InsuffUEcapCauseValue - Summary of email discussion
Type: other		For: discussion
					Source: Ericsson - moderator
Abstract:
Summary of offline discussion
Decision: 		The document was noted.
Discussion on the proposals:
Huawei: no need to align X2 and Xn to F1; use case is different and on Xn and X2 we have the normal release
Nokia: unclear about description: overlaps with any other cause value, even mobility overlaps with MCG mobility cause value
ZTE: 1st cause value, insufficient UE capability; eNB could be aware of this – EN-DC unsupported could be enough for this
Huawei: no clarity on actual issue; list of cells is sent to target and cause value does not discriminate etc.
Ericsson: to ZTE, there is a list of supported bands, but the UE needs to have compatible capabilities; we should avoid repeating this failure (i.e. avoid repeating with multiple tries)
Chair: why not address this issue in signaling? (e.g. à la  X2 Setup Request/Failure)
Huawei: no reason to keep repeating; implementation should somehow cope with this
Ericsson: PCell decided by MN, no list of cells. This is not CA. “CP resources not available” is a temporary failure, so it allows retrying. This is different
Ericsson: OK to further discuss other ways to fixing this; this might help clarifying the scenario
Verizon: we definitely need a solution
ZTE: prefer to continue as contribution-driven

R3-206088	Discussion on One PDU session with Multiple CU-UPs
Type: discussion		For: (not specified)
					Source: ZTE Corporation, China Telecom, CATT
(Replaces R3-204769)
Discussion:
Chair: reflective QoS defined in SA2; why is this needed to be clarified in RAN3? Seems an optimization?
Nokia: RAN2 specs do not allow 2 SDAP entities in the same PDU session; would need RAN2 changes to allow this, and in any case complexity seems a lot compared to the potential benefit
Ericsson: agree with Nok (already discussed and in a SI w.r.t. security – SA3 is currently working on this)
CATT: no technical issue to support this – already supported in MR-DC
ZTE: different QoS flows can be served by different CU-UPs (different slice characteristics), no blocking issue here if same security domain (i.e. different issue w.r.t. what SA3 is discussing)
Nokia: this paper even mentions RAN2 issue here; one PDU session == one slice. This should be a new WI or TEI17.
Ericsson: agree with Nokia – not even a correction
- clarify delta w.r.t. previous discussion
- why another PDU session cannot be used?
- needed in Rel-16?
- Need to involve RAN2?
Decision: 		The document was noted.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction of RAN CP Relocation
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: The original text describing the RAN CP Relocation Indication was moved at last RAN#88 into the successful operation section. However this text is not written in stage 3 style when it describes interaction of multiple procedures involving the UE.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
The text in section 8.3.8.2 is re-drafted in stage 3 style appropriate for NGAP.

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR only has an impact on the RAN CP Relocation Indication function.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: CR38413 for clarification on UE-associated signalling for NBIOT procedures in Rel-16
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: In UE Context Suspend, UE Context Resume, Retrieve UE Information and UE Information Transfer procedures, there are not description on whether they use UE-associated signalling or non UE-associated signalling. Thus, there are ambiguity on whether these procedures use UE-associated signalling or non UE-associated signalling, which may lead un-alignment between AMF and ng-eNB/gNB.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
To clarify that the following procedures use UE-associated signalling:
UE Context Suspend
UE Context Resume
To clarify that the following procedures use Non UE-associated signalling:
Retrieve UE Information
UE Information Transfer

Impact Analysis

Impacted functionality:
The change only impacts the understanding of whether the respective procedures uses UE-associated signalling or non UE-associated signalling.

Inter-operability:
No inter-operability issue is found.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: CR38423 for NR SCG release for power saving
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: The new mechanism on NR SCG release for UE power saving is captured in X2AP and XnAP specifications, but its corresponding text procedure is missing.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Add the corresponding text procedure for the new mechanism.

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
The impact can be considered isolated because the changes affect RRC transfer procedure.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Clarification on an abnormal condition in PDU Session Resource Modify Procedure
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
In clause 8.2.3.2, the original description did not cover the possibility that the same flow ID is included in both the QoS Flow Add or Modify Request List IE and the QoS Flow to Release List IE. 
When that happens, either option
1) NG-RAN node releases this particular QoS flow, then adds it with the requested profiles as listed in the the QoS Flow Add or Modify Request List IE;
or 
2) NG-RAN node regards it as an abnormal case and reports the corresponding QoS flow as failed in the PDU Session Resource Modify Response Transfer IE.
is adopted. Without clear clarification, the IOT issue will happen, and it should be taken as an abnormal condition by the NG-RAN node.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Add the statement for the abnormal condition in PDU Session Resource Modify Procedure.
 
Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolate impact on PDU Session Resource Modify Procedure with the previous version of the specification for implementations following the statement introduced by this CR.
No ASN.1 impact.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: CR38413 for clarification on UE-associated signalling in Rel-16
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: In some NGAP procedures, there are not description on whether they use UE-associated signalling or non UE-associated signalling. Thus, there are ambiguity on whether thy use UE-associated signalling or non UE-associated signalling, which may lead un-alignment between AMF and ng-eNB/gNB.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
To clarify that the following procedures use UE-associated signalling:
        Handover Preparation
        Handover Resource Allocation
        Handover Notification
        Path Switch Request
        Secondary RAT Data Usage Report
 To clarify that the following procedures use non UE-associated signalling:
        RAN Configuration Update
        AMF Configuration Update
        AMF Status Indication

Impact Analysis

Impacted functionality:
The change only impacts the understanding of whether the respective procedures use UE-associated signalling or non UE-associated signalling.

Inter-operability:
No inter-operability issue is found..

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction on V2X related information
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
The HandoverPreparationInformation can include the sidelink related UE information in the scenarios below. 
For the inter-gNB-CU handover, the gNB-CU receives a HandoverPreparationInformation from the source node so it seems the gNB-CU does not need to use an additional CG-ConfigInfo for the sidelink related UE information.
For the intra-gNB-CU inter-gNB-DU handover, if the sidelink UE related information is received from the source gNB-DU, the gNB-CU can also generate a HandoverPreparationInformation to include it for the target gNB-DU.    
The reference of UEAssistanceInformationEUTRA is not defined in TS38.331 and should be referred to TS36.331 instead of TS38.331.
The following is defined in 38.331. Currently, the gNB-DU only provides the SL-ConfigDedicatedEUTRA in the DU to CU information. The gNB-DU should provide sl-TimeOffsetEUTRA-List-r16 as well.

SL-ConfigDedicatedEUTRA-Info-r16 ::=            SEQUENCE {
    sl-ConfigDedicatedEUTRA-r16                    OCTET STRING                                              OPTIONAL,  -- Need M
    sl-TimeOffsetEUTRA-List-r16                    SEQUENCE (SIZE (8)) OF SL-TimeOffsetEUTRA-r16             OPTIONAL    -- Need M
}
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Add TS36.331 to the References section
Add descriptions that if the HandoverPreparationInformation IE containing the sidelink related UE information is included in the UE CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message, the gNB-DU shall regard it as an indication of V2X sidelink information.
Correct the semantics description for UEAssitanceInformationEUTRA
In the DU to CU infomration, the DU provides SL-ConfigDedicatedEUTRA-Info-r16 instead of SL-ConfigDedicatedEUTRA-r16.

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects only the sidelink operation in UE Context Setup procedure, the EUTRA UE Assistance Information, and the SL-ConfigDedicatedEUTRA.
This CR has impact on ASN.1.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction on value range of UAC reduction Indication
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
As defined in current specification, Value 100 UAC reduction Indication IE is stand for full access rate reduction. 
The value 100 is misalignment with the counterpart Traffic Load Reduction Indication IE in NGAP. The value range of this IE is from 1 to 99. The IE indicates the percentage of connection requests to be restricted and allow emergency service request can be served even in congestion situation.
While it is not able to server emergency service request when reduction Indication IE set value 100 in F1AP.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
To clarify Value 99 for UAC reduction Indication IE in F1AP indicates the highest desired rate reduction.

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has minor impact with the previous version of the specification for implementations following the statement introduced by this CR.
gNB-CU not allowed to configure value 100 for UAC reduction Indication IE.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Clarification on an abnormal condition in PDU Session Resource Modify Procedure
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
In clause 8.2.3.2, the original description did not cover the possibility that the same flow ID is included in both the QoS Flow Add or Modify Request List IE and the QoS Flow to Release List IE. 
When that happens, either option
1) NG-RAN node releases this particular QoS flow, then adds it with the requested profiles as listed in the the QoS Flow Add or Modify Request List IE;
or 
2) NG-RAN node regards it as an abnormal case and reports the corresponding QoS flow as failed in the PDU Session Resource Modify Response Transfer IE.
is adopted. Without clear clarification, the IOT issue will happen, and it should be taken as an abnormal condition by the NG-RAN node.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Add the statement for the abnormal condition in PDU Session Resource Modify Procedure.
 
Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolate impact on PDU Session Resource Modify Procedure with the previous version of the specification for implementations following the statement introduced by this CR.
No ASN.1 impact.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Discard NR PDCP PDUs without PDCP PDU transfer
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
The NR user plane protocol provides information of downlink NR PDCP PDUs to be discarded for user data associated with a specific data radio bearer, but the information is included in the PDU Type 0, and currently the specification requires to transfer PDCP PDU in case PDU Type 0 is used.

It is common understanding that it should be allowed to send discard information without transferring a PDCP PDU, clarification needed.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Stage-2 CR on transmission stop for Rel-16 DAPS handover
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
In TS38.401, a NOTE is given for inter-gNB-DU mobility as below:
This note indicates that the source gNB-DU will perform as normal case (non-handover) for data packet transmission, i.e., 
gNB-CU continuously sends DL packets of DAPS bearers to the source gNB-DU
Source gNB-DU continuously schedules DL resource for packet transmission of DAPS and non-DAPS bearers, where packets include the ones already buffered at the source gNB-DU for both DAPS and non-DAPS bearers and the ones from gNB-CU for DAPS bearers
Source gNB-DU continuously schedules UL resource for packet transmission of DAPS and non-DAPS bearers
These behaviors are not aligned with the intention of DAPS handover, and may cause that: non-DAPS bearers may interrupt the data transmission of DAPS bearers

To solve the above problem, it is better to allow the source gNB-DU know the data transmission of which bearers should be stopped during the DAPS handover procedure.

Type: CR		For: Agreement
					38.423 v15.10.0	  CR-0539  Cat: F (Rel-15)

					Source: CATT
Discussion:
Chair: essential correction for Rel-15?
CATT: seen in product; st2 specifies multiple trace configs, no st3 support
ZTE: any drawback in current signaling?
CATT: only 1 trace config can be transferred
Huawei: multiple traces is only if UE has 2 simultaneous CS and PS connections
Nokia: same as Huawei – very old st2 text, from UTRAN times. Not a real problem
Ericsson: this is not logged MDT? Is this signaling or mgmt. based?

Ericsson: is this about configuring UE with multiple configurations or is this about transferring?

Ericsson: same CN, but why 2 trace activations for same UE toward same CN?

CATT: 32.422, NR part also has statements about “different trace references” so it points to this
Chair: liaise SA5?
Ericsson: the new activation replaces the old one; multiple trace activations for the same UE cannot exist
ZTE: requirement should come from SA5; let’s leave it to company coordination
Samsung: same description is in NR st2; consider liaising SA5?
Decision: 		The document was noted.

Nokia: this is a limitation of slices today

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction of SNPN failures
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: There can be failure of non UE-associated procedures due to NPN e.g. NG setup in case of no matching SNPN IDs.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
A generic non UE-asscoiated cause value “NPN not supported” is added.

Rev1
The cause value “Unknown PLMN” is extended to “Unknown PLMN or SNPN” in order to also cover SNPN case.

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR only has an impact on the NPN function.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction of NPN related Cell Information
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
The content related to the NPN-IdentityInfoList IE in SIB1 is missing in the semantics description of the Broadcast PLMN Identity Info List NR IE within Served Cell Information NR. Note that the NPN Broadcast Information IE is already included in the Broadcast PLMN Identity Info List NR IE. 
As specified in TS38.331 (see CellAccessRelatedInfo in clause 6.3.2):
In case of NPN-only cells the PLMN-IdentityList contains a single element that does not count to the limit of 12. 
Therefore, as the range of the Broadcast PLMN Identity Info List NR IE is   0..<maxnoofBPLMNs>, it should be clarified that in case of NPN-only cell, the PLMN Identities and associated information contained in the PLMN-IdentityInfoList IE are not included in the Broadcast PLMN Identity Info List NR IE. Otherwise, the number of Broadcast PLMN Identity Info List NR would be beyond of the limit of 12.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Refine the semantics description of the Broadcast PLMN Identity Info List NR IE within Served Cell Information NR as follows. 
Include the content related to NPN-IdentityInfoList; and 
Clarify that in case of NPN-only cell, the PLMN Identities and associated information contained in the PLMN-IdentityInfoList IE are not included in the Broadcast PLMN Identity Info List NR IE.  


Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
The impact can be considered isolated because it clarifies the contents related to NPN in the Served Cell Information NR.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Including the Redundant UL NG-U UP TNL Information in the Modify Request
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: In PDU Session Resource Modify Request Transfer, the “Additional Redundant UL NG-U UP TNL Information” is defined. But there is no IE for Redundant UL NG-U UP TNL Information in Tabular or ASN.1 code.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
The Redundant UL NG-U UP TNL Information is introduced in PDU Session Resource Modify Request Transfer.
Clarification added on the use of the transport bearer IEs (especially regarding the respective use of the two Redundant UL NG-U UP TNL Information IE present in the PDU Session Resource Modify Request Transfer.

Impact Analysis:
The CR has limited impact.
The ASN.1 change is backwards compatible

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction on UL Configuration handling
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
For MN terminated SCG bearer (only SCG resource is configured for the concerned DRB), if the UL Configuration IE is set to “no data” by the MN, this may lead to a case that there is completely no uplink configuration for the UE for UL user data transmission.

For SN Terminated MCG bearer (only MCG resource is configured for the concerned DRB), if the UL Configuration IE is set to “no data” by the SN, this may lead to a case that there is completely no uplink configuration for the UE for UL user data transmission.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Add in the semantic description for the presence of the UL Configuration IE.




Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact on the functionality of MR-DC in particular with related to UL configuration setting.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Clarification of Secondary RAT in mobility restrictions
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
The Extended RAT Restriction Information IE, introduced in CR0291, includes the Secondary RAT Restriction IE with the following semantics description: 
A Secondary RAT is a RAT used in any cell serving the UE excluding the PCell
It hints the secondary RAT restrictions apply to both SCell restrictions for CA and Secondary Node restrictions for DC, no matter which RAT the primary RAT is.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Clarify that the Secondary RAT is a RAT, distinct from the UE’s primary RAT, used in any cell serving the UE excluding the PCell. 
 
Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
The impact can be considered isolated because the change only affects the Extended RAT Restriction Information.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Clarification of E-CID Measurement Result
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: There is ambiguity whether a gNB can use the E-CID Measurement Result IE to report measured results for E-UTRA. However, the intention is that the IE can only include measured results for the serving RAT, which means a gNB cannot use the IE to report E-UTRA measurements.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
A semantics description is added to clarify that the Measured Results IE within the E-CID Measurement Result IE can only include measurement results of the serving RAT.

Impact analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has an impact under protocol point of view. The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects only E-CID measurement reporting.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: The arrival probability was enabled as part of the CHO mechanism. It is provided from the source node to the target node when a CHO is being prepared. However, in case the target node is split into CU and DU, the DU can’t take any advantege of the information – it is not forwarded to the DU.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
The estimated arrival probability, as defined on XnAP and X2AP, is added to the UE Context Setup and Modification procedures.

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects only one IE.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Introducing Maximum Integrity Protected Data Rate after EPC to 5GC handover
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
Currently the Maximum Integrity Protected Data Rate IE included in the Security Indication IE, is only transferred in the PDU session resource setup procedure, path switch request and Handover Resource Allocation procedure. 

In section 5.17.2.2.2 of TS 23.501, it is described that:


It can be observed after the EPC to 5GC handover, the UE shall initiate the PDU session modification procedure to provide the maximum IP data rate to the SMF, in case these PDU sessions are established at the EPC side. 

This procedure is also described in the section 4.3.3 of TS 23.502 for PDU session modification procedure. 

Hence, when the SMF acquires the UP IP maximum data rate from the UE, it should provide the updated UP IP maximum data rate included in the Security Indication IE in the PDU session resource modify procedure.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Include the ability to change the maximum IP data rate within the Security Indication IE in PDU SESSION RESOURCE MODIFY REQUEST message.
 
Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
The impact can be considered isolated because the change only affects the UP integrity protection after EPC to 5GC handover.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: 38.423 correction for CHO early data forwarding in MN to ng-eNB/gNB Change
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
In Rel-16, CHO can work with MR-DC with 5GC, applied in MN to ng-eNB/gNB Change scenario. In principle, CHO can be prepared with multiple candidate target cells, where data forwarding addresses could be different. In that case, however, it was identified that early data forwarding from S-SN may not work properly, see R3-212282.
Moreover, the prepared CHO can be modified or cancelled, for which the early data forwarding that has been initiated can be cancelled accordingly. This full-fetched operation is currently not possible for S-SN.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
An optional indicator of CHO MR-DC Early Data Forwarding Indicator IE to stop already initiated early data forwarding from the source S-SN is added to the Xn-U Address Indication message together with the corresponding procedural descriptions. 
Editorial corrections on the descriptions of the Xn-U Address Indication and Early Status Transfer procedures. 
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR only has an impact on CHO with MR-DC with 5GC.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: gNB-DU UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate Uplink correction
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: The description of the signalling of gNB-DU UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate Uplink IE makes an incorrect usage of the UL PDU Session Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate IE.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Substitute the UL PDU Session Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate IE with the gNB-DU UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate Uplink IE in the procedure description.

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has no functional and protocol impact to the specifications.

full_retained_Agreement.content:
Re-confirm the previous RAN3 agreement for CHO with LTE/MR-DC that, whenever S-SN decides early data forwarding, S-SN compiles the Early Status Transfer message and sends that to S-MN, which carries DL COUNT value (HFN and PDCP SN) of the first DL PDCP SDU being forwarded to the target.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Private Message Definition
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
The definition of the E1AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE class requires that all values of procedureCode in this information object set should be unique. However, the privateMessage information object is used twice, which leads to an ASN.1 compile error.

Likewise, the introduction of the duplicate privateMessage information object appears to originate from a mistake during implementation of CR R3-204502 (SON/MDT WI).
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Remove duplicated instance of privateMessage information object.

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has an impact under protocol of view. 
The impact can be considered isolated because the change is limited to privateMessage definition.
This CR is ASN.1 backwards compatible.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction on SRB ID
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
In TS 38.473, SRB ID IE that corresponds to SRB-Identity is defined with the value range of 0 – 3. However, the SRB-Identity specified in TS 38.331 is with the value range of 1 – 3, as SRB0 is not needed to be explicitly indicated over the radio. 

Regarding the above misalignment in the value range, the value 0 cannot be derived from the current Semantics description; therefore, it is needed to update the Semantics description of the SRB ID IE to enable it.

SRB ID IE in TS 38.473: 

SRB-Identity IE in TS 38.331: 
-- ASN1START
-- TAG-SRB-IDENTITY-START

SRB-Identity ::=                    INTEGER (1..3)

-- TAG-SRB-IDENTITY-STOP
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Clearify the SRB ID IE corresponds to the SRB Identities defined in TS 38.331, instead of the SRB-Identity IE. 

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has no impact with the previous version of the specification (same release) because the change only affects the description of SRB ID IE.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction of the DAPS Response Information IE in the tabular
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
In the RAN3#108-e, RAN3 agreed on the per DRB DAPS response. 
While this is reflected in ASN.1, DAPS Response Information IE only has DAPS Response Indicator, not in the form of the list, in the tabular. 
Therefore, the tabular needs to be alinged to ASN.1.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
To align the tabular with ASN.1, a list structure including the DRB ID has been added in the DAPS Response Information in the tabular.

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has an impact on tabular rpresentation of the the DAPS Response Information IE in the HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message, and the change is backward compatible.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Interactions with other procedures for the UE TNLA BINDING RELEASE
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
For the UE TNLA Binding Release Request message, the interactions with other procedures are described that the ongoing procedures (except for the NG reset or another UE TNLA Binding release message) shall be aborted as follows. 

Interactions with other procedures:
If the UE TNLA BINDING RELEASE REQUEST message is received, any other ongoing procedure (except for the NG Reset procedure or another UE TNLA Binding Release procedure) on the same NG interface related to the UE indicated in the UE TNLA BINDING RELEASE REQUEST message shall be aborted.
However consider the following procedures. 
The AMF sends the PDU Session Resource Setup Request to the NG-RAN;
The NG-RAN sends the RRCreconfiguration to the UE;
Before the NG-RAN sends PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP RESPONSE message, the AMF sends the UE TNLA Binding Release Request to the NG-RAN node;
The NG-RAN has to abort the transfer of the PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP RESPONSE message, if following the above interactions. 

However this will introduce the misalignment between the AMF, and the UE. Note that this procedure may happen due to the fact that the AMF is transparent about the SMF information, and initiates the TNLA Binding Release if any need.  

In addition, as specified in the section 4.2.7.2.3	 Re-Creating NGAP UE-TNLA-bindings subsequent to NGAP UE-TNLA-binding release of TS 23. 502, the detailed actions for the NG-RAN and AMF have been specified clearly. 

If the AMF has released the NGAP UE-TNLA-binding in the 5G-AN node for a UE, and the 5G-AN node needs to send an N2 message for this UE, the following applies:
-	The 5G-AN node checks the GUAMI stored in the UE context and the associated AMF:
……
-	The 5G-AN node creates an NGAP UE-TNLA-binding for the UE by selecting a TNL association from the available TNL associations permitted for the initial N2 message with the selected AMF, as defined in TS 23.501 [2] clause 5.21.1.3,and sends the N2 message to the AMF via the selected TNL association.
- If the NGAP UE-TNLA-binding has been released for a UE and the AMF needs to send an N2 message for this UE, the following applies:
……
Typically, for the above procedures, the NG-RAN can send the PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP RESPONSE message, by selecting a TNL association from the available TNL associations within the selected AMF, as specified in 4.2.7.2.3 of TS 23.502.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Remove the interactions with other procedures for the UE TNLA BINDING RELEASE REQUEST message, and add reference to TS 23.502.

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release) because it is related to the UE TNLA BINDING RELEASE REQUEST procedure. 
The impact can be considered isolated.

-	The 5G-AN node creates an NGAP UE-TNLA-binding for the UE by selecting a TNL association from the available TNL associations permitted for the initial N2 message with the selected AMF, as defined in TS 23.501 [2] clause 5.21.1.3,and sends the N2 message to the AMF via the selected TNL association.
- If the NGAP UE-TNLA-binding has been released for a UE and the AMF needs to send an N2 message for this UE, the following applies:
……
Typically, for the above procedures, the NG-RAN can send the PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP RESPONSE message, by selecting a TNL association from the available TNL associations within the selected AMF, as specified in 4.2.7.2.3 of TS 23.502.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Maximum number of NRCGI over E1 [EXT_NRCGI_E1]
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
Current E1AP specification limits the IE to signal the number of cells at a gNB-CU-UP to 512, which is not aligned with the maximum number of cells supported by a gNB (e.g,, for the case where a gNB-CU-UP serves multiple gNB-DUs). 

This limitation can be overcome by introducing an optional Extended NR-CGI Support List IE, which the gNB-CU-UP can use to convey more than 512 cells.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Introduce Extended NR-CGI Support List IE to E1 Setup and gNB-CU-UP Configuration Update procedures.

This CR has an impact under functional and protocol point of view 
The impact can be considered isolated because the change is limited to E1 Setup and gNB-CU-UP Configuration Update procedures. 
This CR is ASN.1 backwards compatible

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction of PDU Session Modify
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
1/ the UL NG-U UP TNL Information IE in the PDU Session Resource Modify Confirm Transfer IE shall be included in the PDU SESSION RESOURCE MODIFY CONFIRM message, otherwise the tunnel would be missing an UL endpoint. The “may” statement”, making this optional is erroneous. (IE is mandatory in asn.1)

2/ if the Security Result IE is included in the PDU Session Resource Modify Indication Transfer IE, this means that the security indication was earlier sent by SMF. Again there is then no optionality for SMF to consider it as new result or not. It shall be considered by the SMF as the new result to be compliant.

3/The semantics of the UL NG-U UP TNL Information IE in the PDU Session Resource Modify Confirm Transfer IE includes a wrong reference of IE name.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
NG-RAN behaviour changed into “shall” in several places.
Erroneous IE name is corrected.

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR only has an impact on the PDU Session Resource Modification Indication function.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: It is unclear if the PDU Type 0 or the PDU Type 1 should be used over the PDU Session Forwarding tunnel from source NG-RAN node to UPF in case of 5g to 4g handover.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
It is clarified that the source NG-RAN node sends the forwarded packet to the forwarding UPF including in the RAN container the PDU Type 0 frame received from the Anchor UPF in alignment with the intra-system indirect handover.

Rev 1:
TS 38.415 is corrected so that the DL PDU SESSION INFORMATION frame can also be used from NG-RAN to UPF for data forwarding.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction of Allocated C-RNTI for 2-step RACH
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
The 2-step RACH has been captured as R16 feature. In TS 38.321, the MSGB is introduced, and the two new RAR formats wherein are given as follows. 

the success RAR is defined when the gNB successfully decodes the msgA, wherein the C-RNTI shall be included.
The fallback RAR is defined when the gNB successufully detects the preamble but failes to decode the payload in the MsgA, where the temporary C-RNTI is included. 

In the XnAP RETRIEVE UE CONTEXT REQUEST message, the serving gNB  shall forward the C-RNTI to the target gNB as the input of the short MAC-I for next potential release. 

But currently the semantics descriptions for the Allocated C-RNTI IE is not fully correct, where only the temporary C-RNTI for 4-step RACH is described.

Figure 6.2.3a-2: successRAR

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Clarification of the use of the max no of CHO preparations
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: One of the features agreed within the scope of the Mobility Enhancements WI in Rel.16 was the conditional handover (CHO), which enables the source node to prepare multiple candidate cells for a UE. In order to avoid overload, RAN3 enabled the target node to indicate how many CHO preparations may be simulataneously active. However, the description of the feature suggests the limit concerns the number of CHO preparations that may be triggered for the UE – so that possible replacing of a CHO, or CHO after cancelling another target cell also count to the limit.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
The description of the new IE is clarified that the limit concerns prepared cells for CHO.

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
The impact can be considered isolated because the change only clarifies meaning of the IE.
