original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction on Abnormal Conditions in Handover Preparation Procedure for R15
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
Current specification describes that if the NG-RAN node receives at least one PDU Session ID included in the PDU Session Resource Handover List IE without at least one valid associated GTP tunnel address pair (in either UL or DL), then the NG-RAN node shall consider it as a logical error. 
For inter-system handover, PDU Session Resource Handover List IE is optional. If no data forwarding is needed, AMF will not convey PDU Session Resource Handover List IE in Handover command. If data forwarding is accepted, but no at least one vaild associated GTP tunnel address pair in  PDU Session Resource Handover List IE (in either UL or DL), then NG-RAN node shall consider it as a logical error. The current description is fine.
For intra-system handover, PDU Session Resource Handover List IE is mandatory. If no data forwarding is needed, AMF do send PDU Session Resource Handover List IE but Handover Command Transfer is empty. So no at least one valid associated GTP tunnel address pair in PDU Session Resource Handover List IE is not an abnormal condition when data forwarding is not required (in either UL or DL) in intra-system handover.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Adding a restriction to limit current abnormal contributions of handover preparation in inter-system handover.
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR is a clarification and has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR only has an impact on handover preparation.
This CR is backward compatible.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction on SN initiated SN Modification procedure for EN-DC
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
In the SgNB initiated SgNB modification procedure for EN-DC, MN cannot reject the release request of E-RAB(s) from SN, which means there is no such case that the MN needs to indicate the E-RABs to be released in the SGNB MODIFICATION CONFIRM message. Thus the released E-RABs in the following paragraph should be removed.

For each E-RAB successfully modified or released as requested by the en-gNB, the MeNB shall inform the en-gNB, in the SGNB MODIFICATION CONFIRM message, the same value in the EN-DC Resource Configuration IE as received in the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUIRED message.

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).
This CR only has an impact on the SN initiated SN Modification procedure.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: (NGAP CR) support the UE Radio Capability for Paging in RACS context
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: Per SA2 LS (R3-214709/S2-2106821), the NG-RAN node needs to provide the E-UTRAN UE Radio Capability for Paging and NR UE Radio Capability for Paging to the AMF, in order to support Mode of operation A.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Clarify the AMF behavior upon the reception of the UE Radio Capability for Paging of NR IE and the UE Radio Capability for Paging of E-UTRA IE.


Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has limited impact under funtional point of view. The CR clarify the AMF behavior.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: (S1AP CR) support the UE Radio Capability for Paging in RACS context
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: Per SA2 LS (R3-214709/S2-2106821), the eNB needs to provide the E-UTRAN UE Radio Capability for Paging and NR UE Radio Capability for Paging to the AMF, in order to support Mode of operation A.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Introduce the UE Radio Capability for Paging – NR Format IE encoded in TS 38.331 format in the S1AP UE CAPABILITY INFO INDICATION message.

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has limited impact under funtional point of view. The CR has an ASN.1 impact limited to the introduction of support for UE Radio Capabality for Paging in RACS context.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction on PRS-only TP
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
In RAN2#115 meeting, the CR R2-2108956 was agreed. In this CR, the LMF can send a indication to the UE regarding the PRS-only TP.
 NR-DL-PRS-AssistanceDataPerTRP-r16 ::= SEQUENCE {
	dl-PRS-ID-r16					INTEGER (0..255),
	nr-PhysCellID-r16				NR-PhysCellID-r16			OPTIONAL,	-- Need ON
	nr-CellGlobalID-r16				NCGI-r15						OPTIONAL,	-- Need ON
	nr-ARFCN-r16						ARFCN-ValueNR-r15			OPTIONAL,	-- Need ON
	nr-DL-PRS-SFN0-Offset-r16		NR-DL-PRS-SFN0-Offset-r16,
	nr-DL-PRS-ExpectedRSTD-r16		INTEGER (-3841..3841),
	nr-DL-PRS-ExpectedRSTD-Uncertainty-r16	
									INTEGER (0..246),
	nr-DL-PRS-Info-r16				NR-DL-PRS-Info-r16,
	... ,
	[[
		prs-OnlyTP-v16xy				ENUMERATED { true }		OPTIONAL		-- Need ON	
	]]
}

However, in the current TRP information exchange procedure, the gNB can not send the information of TP type to the LMF. Therefore, the TP type information should be added, in order to align with RAN2.

Also, in the OTDOA positioining procedure, the LMF can collect the TP type from the ng-eNB. In the OTDOA Information Request message, the TP type can be request:

In stage 2, the following TRP types are introduced:
Transmission Point (TP)
Reception Point (RP) 
PRS-only TP 
SRS-only RP 
Transmission-Reception Point (TRP). 
It would be necessary to let the LMF know the type of the TRP.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Add the TRP types TP in the TRP information exchange procedure.

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).

The impact can be considered isolated because the change only affects the TRP information exchange.

This change is backward compatible.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Redundant network instance for split PDU session
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
At last RAN3-113-e meeting, the CR R3-214406 was agreed, to add the common network instance into the UP Transport Layer Information List IE. 
But the procedural text does not clearly state to which exact scenario it applies i.e. whether this applies only to the Additional UL NG-U UP TNL Information IE or also to the Additional Redundant UL NG-U UP TNL Information IE.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Clarify the Common Network Instance IE included in the UP Transport Layer Information List IE can be used for both the Additional UL NG-U UP TNL Information IE or also to the Additional Redundant UL NG-U UP TNL Information IE .
Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
The impact can be considered isolated because the change only affects the redundant data transmission.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Redundant network instance for split PDU session
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
At last RAN3-113-e meeting, the CR R3-214407 was agreed, to add the Common Network Instance into the Additional UL NG-U UP TNL Information at UPF List. 
But it is unclear if it applies to all the cases when the IE is included i.e. whether it applies also to the Additional Redundant UL NG-U UP TNL Information at UPF List.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Clarify that the Common Network Instance applies to both the Additional UL NG-U UP TNL Information at UPF List IE and the Additional Redundant UL NG-U UP TNL Information at UPF List IE.
Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
The impact can be considered isolated because the change only affects the redundant data transmission.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Adding reference for coding of Common Network Instance
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: The Common Newotk Instance IE is defined as OCTET STRING, its usage refer to 23.501, and described as “in a format common with 5GC” but its coding has no reference. 23.501 does not show any coding format. This is not encodable and not decodable if different vendors will have individual own coding.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Add in the semantic description of the Common Network Instance IE, refer to 29.244


Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact because it adds reference of the common network instance IE, which impact only network instrance aspect.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: E1 impact to support to stop CHO early data forwarding
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: In case of the preparations of CHO cancelled, for the source node with split CU-CP and CU-UP architecture, source CU-CP should inform to source CU-UP to stop early data forwarding before. However, in the current TS 38.463, no such IE is used to support this function. Therefore, necessary enhancement for E1AP is needed.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: DAPS Inconsistencies
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
Inconsistencies regarding tabular and ASN.1 regarding DAPS Information IE
Missing DAPS Request Information IE in DRB To Setup List IE within PDU Session Resource To Modify List IE (section 9.3.3.11 PDU Session Resource To Modify List) as it is already supported in this IE’s ASN.1 encoding (i.e. dRB-To-Setup-List-NG-RAN)
Correction to inconsistencies introduced via R3-213939, where the changes intended were introduced to different IEs in tabular and ASN.1. This incurs two issues.
Issue 1: DAPS Request Info IE was introduced in DRB To Modify List IE within PDU Session Resource To Modify List IE (section 9.3.3.11 PDU Session Resource To Modify List). However, it is missing on ASN.1 for this IE (i.e. PDU-Session-Resource-To-Modify-List). 
Issue 2: DAPS Request Information IE was introduced in ASN.1 of DRB-To-Setup-Mod-Item-NG-RAN within PDU-Session-Resource-To-Setup-Mod-List. However, it is missing on the tabular of this IE (section 9.3.3.10 PDU Session Resource To Setup Modification List). and also appears this was introduced by mistake in ASN.1. Thus, it is proposed to be deprecated to avoid non-backward compatible changes.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Add DAPS Request Information IE in DRB To Setup List IE within PDU Session Resource To Modify List IE tabular
Add Daps Request Information IE in ASN.1 of dRB-To-Modify-List-NG-RAN 
Add DAPS Request Information IE to DRB To Be Setup Item IE within PDU Session Resource To Setup Modification List IE in tabular.

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has an impact under functional and protocol point of view. 
The impact can be considered isolated because the change is limited to DAPS function.
This CR is ASN.1 backwards compatible.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Incorrect Node Name IE in ASN.1
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: The Extended gNB-CU-Node-Name and gNB-DU-Node-Name are incorrectly placed in ASN.1 of F1 SETUP REQUEST and F1 SETUP RESPONSE messages.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Introduce Extended-gNB-DU-Node-Name in F1 SETUP REQUEST and Extended-gNB-CU-Node-Name in F1 SETUP RESPONSE messages and remove the incorrect Information Elements accordingly. 

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has an impact under functional point of view. 
The impact can be considered isolated because the change is limited to the Extended Node names in the F1 Setup procedure.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Location Reporting (PS Reporting on XnAP)
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
Rel-15 has introduced location reporting of PSCell. While an NG-RAN node can be configured to apply this function for a UE, it is not possible to transfer that information to the target/new NG-RAN node in case of Xn mobility.
Note, that stage-2 specification (TS 23.502) assumes transfer of such information via Xn.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
The an Additional Location Reporting Information is included in the Location Reporting Information to allow transferring respective control information received from the 5GC.
Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release) because it introduces the possibility to transfer control information regarding report of PSCell via Xn within the UE context.
The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects only the location reporting function.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction to S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUIRED message
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: Currently, when the S-NG-RAN node requests the release of a SN terminated PDU session for a specific UE to the M-NG-RAN node, the S-NG-RAN node can not indicate the cause since the cause value is missing in PDU sessions to be released List – SN terminated IE
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Add cause value to PDU sessions to be released List – SN terminated IE in S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUIRED message.

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact on the functionality of Handover preparation procedure procedure.
This CR is backward compatible.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction for UL PDU Session Information
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
Last RAN3 meeting agreed the CRs on PDU Type Frame to clarify that the DL PDU Session Inforamtion frame can be used for data forwarding, with the following change (the initial intention is used to clarify the NG-RAN to UPF data forwarding). 
In the case of uplink and downlink data forwarding the DL PDU Session Information procedure shall be used to send control information elements related to the PDU Session from UPF/NG-RAN to NG-RAN/UPF.

However, it is not clear what the above text “UPF/NG-RAN to NG-RAN/UPF” exactly means and more precisely if it also applies from NG-RAN node to NG-RAN node.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Clairied that the DL PDU session information (PDU type 0) is used for UL/DL PDU session tunnel data forwarding in case of intra-system handover for all cases of NG-RAN to UPF, or from UPF to NG-RAN, or between NG-RAN nodes. 
 
Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
The impact can be considered isolated because the change only affects the data forwarding function.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: CR to 38.463 on support of Pre-shared key derivation for IAB-donor-CU-UP
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason: In the current specification, the KgNB is used to calculate the PSK (KIAB) to establish the IPSec protection for F1 interface between the IAB-node (gNB-DU) and the IAB-donor-CU, but KgNB is not transferred from CU-CP to CU-UP in case of CP-UP separation. The IAB-donor-CU-UP is not able to derive KIAB because of the absence of KgNB, and how to obtain the KIAB at the IAB-donor-CU-UP is missing from the current specification, then the establishment of IPsec Security Association (SA) will fail.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
In section 8.1, add new procedure “IAB PSK Notification” in the class 2 peocedure table.
Add new clause 8.5.x to capture the procedure description for the new introduced IAB PSK Notification procedure. 
Add new clause 9.2.4.x to capture the tabular for the IAB-donor-CU-UP PSK.
Add new clause 9.3.1.x to include the new introduced IE: IAB-donor-CU-UP PSK.
Update the ASN.1 part from 9.4.3 to 9.4.7 to capture the new introduced procedure.

Impact analysis
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release) because the changes only impact IAB functionality.
This CR has an impact under functional point of view. 
The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects only the IAB related procedure.
The changes are backward compatible.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction of frequency information for DL only or UL only cell
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
The Cell Direction IE can be included in the Served Cell Information to indicate whether the cell is unidirectional, as agreed in R3-190956 as follows. 



But in the served cell information, in case of FDD, the UL/DL FreqInfo IEs and UL/DL Transmission Bandwidth (with corresponding UL/DL carrier list) are mandatory. This means if the cell is indicated as DL only cell, the UL FreqInfo/UL transmission bandwidth are indicated as well, which potentially lead to confusion. The same is true for UL only cell but with DL FreqInfo/DL transmission bandwidth.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Update the semantic descriptions that for DL only cell, the UL related frequency information is ignored, while for UL only cell, the DL related frequency information is ignored.  

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).
The impact can be considered isolated because the change only affects the served cell information.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: Correction of frequency information for DL only cell
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
In served/neighbour information NR IE, the UL/DL NR frequency info and UL/DL transmission bandwidth are mandatory. 
However as indicated in the section 5.2 in TS 38.401, the SDL is operating in the DL operating band only. 

This means if the cell is SDL cell, the UL FreqInfo/UL transmission bandwidth are indicated as well, which may potentially lead to confusion and errors.  

Note that for LTE UL EARFCN in the Served Cell Information E-UTRA, it is already clearly indicated that 
Corresponds to NUL in TS 36.104 [25] for E-UTRA operating bands for which it is defined; ignored for E-UTRA operating bands for which NUL is not defined
Then the similar semantic descriptions can be included for NR UL frequency info as well.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Update the semantic descriptions that for SDL cell, the UL related frequency information is ignored. 

Impact Analysis:
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): 
This CR has isolated impact with the previous version of the specification (same release).

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
For the data forwarding for SN-terminated bearers, and for handover from the ENDC to SA, 
the data forwarding can happen from the source SgNB to the target gNB (i.e. source SgNB->SGW(PGW)->UPF->target gNB). 

While in the current ENDC procedures, the forwarding addresses are described as the X2 transport bearer used for forwarding of DL/UL PDUs, e.g, as excerpted from the SGNB RELEASE REQUEST message below: 

It can be observed that this semantic descriptions highly restrict that the data forwarding happens only via the MN for SN-terminated bearers.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Update the semantic descriptions for UL Forwarding GTP Tunnel Endpoint IE and DL Forwarding GTP Tunnel Endpoint IE to remove the restriction of the data forwarding only via the MN.

original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.title: CR for 38.463 on fixing DAPS HO handling inconsistency during Bearer Context Modification procedure
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.reason:
During Rel-16 mobility enhancement work, R3-204512 (BL CR for 38.463) introduced DAPS Request Information IE onto DRB To Setup List of 9.3.3.2 PDU Session Resource To Setup List to support DAPS HO when establishing bearer context in the target CU-UP (via Bearer Context Setup procedure). In ASN.1, the IE was added to DRB-To-Setup-List-NG-RAN but since DRB-To-Setup-List-NG-RAN is also used for DRB To Setup List of 9.3.3.11 PDU Session Resource To Modify List, so the CR R3-216162 in RAN3#114-e meeting fixed the misalignment and added the IE onto the tabular of DRB To Setup List in 9.3.3.11 PDU Session Resource To Modify List. 
While fixing this misalignment between tabular and ASN.1 is correct, in fact there is no usage to establish new DRB for DAPS HO during Bearer Context Modification procedure. The only usage during Bearer Context Modification procedure is to support intra-gNB-CU-UP DAPS HO, where the DAPS Request Information IE is carried by DRB To Modify List within 9.3.3.11 PDU Session Resource To Modify List, not by DRB To Setup List. As a result, it is proposed to deprecate this IE in DRB To Setup List of 9.3.3.11 PDU Session Resource To Modify List.
original_pre_cutoff_linked_CR_records.summary:
Fixed the semantic of DAPS Request Information IE in DRB To Setup List of 9.3.3.11 PDU Session Resource To Modify List by "This IE is not used in this version of the specification".
Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).
The impact can be considered isolated because the change is limited to DAPS function during Bearer Context Modification procedure.
